meta.source: Sherley Farms Phase 1A/1B/1C grading plans (Ph_1A_Grading.dwg, Ph_1B_Grading.dwg, Ph_1C_Grading.dwg), layers C-GRAD-PADS-TEXT and C-GRAD-TEXT, read 2026-11-10.
meta.what: Finished-grade elevation labels as the engineer placed them. FP = finished pad, FG = finished spot grade, TC = top of curb, TW = top of retaining wall, BW = bottom of wall.
meta.coords: x,y are in the same coordinate space as each lot’s pts, so they can be drawn directly.
meta.elevations: The grading plans abbreviate a spot elevation to its last two digits and decimal — 82.5F is 682.5. The hundreds were restored from the nearest FP label on the same sheet rather than assumed, so a label near a hundred-foot boundary resolves to the right century.
meta.catchment: A label within 12 ft outside a lot line is included for that lot, which is how alley, curb and street spots reach the lot they serve. "in":0 marks those. A label on a shared line appears on both lots, deliberately.
meta.scope: OCH lots only. The drawings carry labels for all 418 lots in Phase 1.
meta.caveat: Preliminary. Confirm against the surveyed plot plan.
